rules.message: nmi handler entry: expected push cs / pop ds / push bp (0E 1F 55); found {prefix}

rules.message: exactly one far RETF (CB) required; found {count}, expected 1. The far-jump to KBDNMI must be the only RETF
rules.rationale: push bx / push ax / retf far-jump idiom; one CB only

rules.message: nmi handler epilogue: expected pop bp / push bx / push ax / retf (5D 53 50 CB); found {suffix}
rules.rationale: chain exit: restore BP, far-jump to saved KBDNMI, never RETF-to-BASIC
